empty: No local server yet. Addresses show up here when a run prints one (http://localhost:<port>) or when the project gives this worktree a port.
frame: Page preview of {{url}}. Press Enter to move the keyboard into the page; Esc brings it back.
frameEmpty: Nothing is loaded. A page loads only when you press Load.
picking: Click an element in the page. Esc cancels.
failed: Could not load {{url}}: {{description}}. Check that the dev server is running.
crashed: The page stopped ({{description}}). Reload to try again.

blocked.host: Blocked {{url}}: the preview only opens this task's local server.
blocked.port: Blocked {{url}}: that port is not this task's dev server.
blocked.scheme: Blocked {{url}}: only http and https pages open here.
blocked.credentials: Blocked {{url}}: addresses with a user name or password do not open here.
blocked.invalid: Blocked an address that is not a valid URL.
blocked.window: The page tried to open {{url}} in a new window. New windows are blocked; use Open in browser.
blocked.download: The page tried to download {{url}}. Downloads are blocked in the preview.
blocked.frame: Blocked a frame that tried to open {{url}}.

refused.host: Only this task's local server can load here.
refused.port: That port is not this task's dev server any more. Refresh the list.
refused.scheme: Only http and https addresses load here.
refused.credentials: Addresses with a user name or password do not load here.
refused.invalid: That address is not a valid URL.
refused.no_window: The window is not ready yet. Try again.

pickFailed: Picking did not work on this page. Reload it and try again.
pickInvalid: The page answered with something that is not an element. Nothing was kept.
pickedCut: The HTML was cut to 16 KB.
shotAlt: Screenshot of {{selector}} as the preview showed it
shotHint: Only this element's area of the page goes with the message. Remove it to send the text alone.
shotAsPath: This runner cannot take images, so it gets the screenshot's file path in the text.
shotNone: No screenshot: none of the element was in view. Scroll it into view and pick again to include one.
quoteLabel: What the agent receives, quoted as page data
notePlaceholder: What should change about this element?
queueHint: It joins the step's queue and reaches the agent at its next turn. You can still edit or delete it there.
noRun: This step has no run to send it to.
runDone: This run has finished, so nothing more can be queued for it.
closeNote: Unloading the page or closing this panel never stops the dev server or the agent.
